```{r}
# Load Librariess
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Read in data
cities <- read.csv("cities.csv")
outlook <- read.csv("outlook_meanings.csv")
forecast <- read.csv("weather_forecasts.csv")
```

```{r}
sum(is.na(cities))      # How many missing values in cities file?
sum(is.na(outlook))     # How many missing values in outlook file?
sum(is.na(forecast))    # How many missing values in forecast file?
```

```{r}
# 2. Check for duplicate rows
sum(duplicated(cities))     # How many repeated rows in cities?
sum(duplicated(outlook))    # How many repeated rows in outlook?
sum(duplicated(forecast))   # How many repeated rows in forecast?
```


```{r}
head(cities)       # Shows top rows of cities data
head(outlook)      # Shows top rows of outlook data
head(forecast)     # Shows top rows of forecast data
```

```{r}
# For cities dataset
str(cities)         # Shows data types and example values
names(cities)       # Lists column names

# For outlook dataset
str(outlook)
names(outlook)

# For forecast dataset
str(forecast)
names(forecast)

```
